parent_snapshot.immutability_rule: B2 and F0 may reference F-1 but may never rewrite any F-1 artifact, parameter, seed, probability or seat output.

purpose: Build the strongest falsifiable non-agentic structured political-evidence layer that can be added to the frozen F-1 structural prior before any experiment in agentic collection or reasoning.

scientific_role.null_hypothesis: Structured pre-election political facts add no out-of-sample predictive information beyond F-1.
scientific_role.alternative_hypothesis: A preregistered deterministic transformation of admissible structured political facts improves proper scores and/or seat calibration beyond F-1.
scientific_role.agentic_boundary: No autonomous source discovery, discretionary LLM salience scoring, sentiment score, narrative forecast, chain-of-thought feature, or model-selected post-hoc claim may enter B2. Engineering the deterministic pipeline is not credited as agentic alpha.

time_contract.cutoff_rule: The B2 freeze certificate records one exact cutoff no later than its execution time. Only claims whose publication timestamp and first-observed timestamp are both at or before that cutoff are eligible for F0.
time_contract.late_evidence_rule: Evidence first observed after the cutoff is retained in an append-only later-snapshot queue and cannot be backdated into F0.

admissible_evidence_classes.acceptance: Authoritative T0 source required. T1 or media reports may create a pending lead but never a mechanical constraint.
T0; or T1 plus one independent T2; or two independent T2 sources. Conflicted facts are excluded.
The event must be objectively timestamped and satisfy its type-specific source rule. Generic controversy, tone, crowd-size interpretation and sentiment are inadmissible.

source_tiers.T0: Authoritative state, legal, parliamentary or official election-administration publication.
source_tiers.T1: Official party, coalition, candidate or office-holder publication; admissible for self-reported actions, not independent impact claims.
source_tiers.T2: Established national professional news organization with named publication and timestamp.
source_tiers.T3: Professional regional/local news organization with attributable publication and timestamp.
source_tiers.T4: Unverified social post, repost, aggregator, anonymous account or unsourced claim; lead generation only and never admissible evidence.

explicit_exclusions_v1: Opinion polls and seat forecasts: excluded until a separate poll-integration protocol is frozen and backtested.
Private intelligence, interviews not publicly archived, leaked documents and unverifiable claims.
Sentiment, popularity, momentum, rally-size or media-tone judgments.
Any 2026 election outcome, post-election data or outcome-derived label.
Any evidence selected because it moves the forecast in a preferred direction.
Any free-form LLM score, embedding similarity used as a political effect, or agent-generated confidence value.

identity_and_provenance.record_id: SHA-256 of canonical claim fields prefixed b2_
identity_and_provenance.candidate_id: Deterministic normalized full name plus birthdate when authoritative; collisions remain unresolved rather than guessed.
identity_and_provenance.party_id: Canonical party code from the frozen party crosswalk; unknown codes are quarantined.
identity_and_provenance.territory_id: Must match the certified 92-local or 12-regional geometry; no fuzzy territorial assignment is accepted without a reviewed alias entry.
identity_and_provenance.raw_preservation: Every admissible record retains source locator, publication timestamp, first-observed timestamp, document/content hash and claim/excerpt hash.
identity_and_provenance.deduplication: Canonical claim key plus source-content hash. Repetition of the same wire copy does not count as independent corroboration.
identity_and_provenance.conflict_rule: Conflicting admissible claims are marked CONFLICTED and excluded from transformations until resolved by a higher-tier source or explicit correction.

collection_contract.source_universe: A domain/document allowlist must be frozen in b2_source_registry.json before claim collection begins.
collection_contract.query_templates: Queries and page paths are versioned in the source registry; discretionary expansion creates a new source-registry version.
collection_contract.extraction: Structured API/table parsing, deterministic regex, or human double-entry reconciliation. LLM semantic extraction may be evaluated later as E_collect but is forbidden in B2.
collection_contract.critical_double_entry: Ballot presence, candidate identity/rank, party switch and birthdate require two matching parses/entries or one authoritative structured table plus hash verification.
collection_contract.missingness: Missing is NA, never silently converted to zero or absence. Official full-coverage ballot tables may establish absence only after the coverage gate passes.

feature_and_effect_contract.mechanical_features: May constrain ballot support or statutory tie handling after authoritative verification; they do not receive fitted vote-share coefficients.
feature_and_effect_contract.predictive_features: All coefficients are locked at zero until the frozen historical calibration gate passes.
feature_and_effect_contract.historical_panel: Candidate/list/evidence features must be reconstructed at the same information cutoff for 2011->2016 and 2016->2021 without using the target outcome during feature creation.
feature_and_effect_contract.minimum_coverage: At least 80% of the 92 local territories in each transition for the core feature panel.
feature_and_effect_contract.minimum_support: A binary feature requires at least 30 positive historical territory-transition instances; otherwise its F0 coefficient remains exactly zero and the feature is reporting-only.
feature_and_effect_contract.target: Territory-level ILR vote-composition residual and turnout-logit residual relative to the frozen persistence mean.
feature_and_effect_contract.model_family: Ridge-regularized hierarchical residual model with national and region interactions only; no territory-specific free coefficient and no free 92x92 covariance.
feature_and_effect_contract.selection: Fit on 2011->2016 and validate on 2016->2021 using a frozen regularization grid. No feature family or hyperparameter may be added after validation results are observed.
proper_scores: Brier/log score for discrete seat events where applicable
feature_and_effect_contract.promotion_rule: B2 may shift F0 only if the preregistered aggregate score improves versus F-1 and no mandatory calibration/coverage metric degrades beyond its frozen tolerance.
feature_and_effect_contract.effect_cap: Each predicted ILR residual is norm-capped at the empirical 90th percentile of absolute historical persistence residuals computed only from the fit transition; cap values are published before 2026 application.
feature_and_effect_contract.failure_rule: If calibration, support or coverage fails, B2 remains a structured factual layer with mechanical constraints only; no narrative or hand-set vote shift is substituted.

F0_contract.required_parent: The registered F-1 forecast hash must match exactly.
F0_contract.required_B2_state: B2-FROZEN certificate PASS with all evidence and transformation hashes.
counterfactual_outputs: F0 distribution after admissible mechanical constraints and calibrated B2 residual
territory/party delta attributable to each B2 feature family
F0_contract.immutability: F0 receives a unique append-only snapshot ID and never overwrites F-1.
F0_contract.agentic_exclusion: F0 is generated before E_collect, E_reason or E_full is unlocked.

versioning.protocol_changes: Any change to evidence classes, source rules, feature definitions, calibration family, thresholds or caps requires b2_protocol_v2 or later and preserves V1.
versioning.record_corrections: Corrections append a superseding record referencing the prior record_id; records are never silently edited.
versioning.outcome_lock: No B2 protocol or evidence record may be altered after the first 2026 outcome becomes observable.
